body.title: Contract-test the relocation and the real catalog's self-consistency
body.summary: Add src/config/__tests__/config-catalog-contract.test.ts asserting the module-boundary and catalog-integrity properties no runtime test can observe. Static source scan over src/config/** (read files, parse import specifiers — no new dependency) asserting zero imports of src/cli; assert src/config/config-catalog.ts is the single definition site and that the symbol re-exported from src/cli/config-catalog.ts is reference-identical to it; assert every real CONFIG_CATALOG row's declared type is inside the discriminant domain and every row's default satisfies its own predicate (i.e. reconcileConfig({}, CONFIG_CATALOG) does not throw ConfigCatalogError); assert reconcileConfig is idempotent on the real 41-row catalog. Add the tsc-checked never-assignment fixture proving the predicate switch is exhaustive. This task owns six of the seven LLD contract-level subjects; the seventh — MaintenanceResult.configReconcile being optional and additive — is owned by t11 and must not be duplicated here (record that split in a comment at the top of this file so the ac6 contract row has one unambiguous owner).
acceptanceChecks: The source-scan assertion over src/config/** for src/cli imports runs green against the current tree and fails if such an import is introduced
`import { CONFIG_CATALOG } from '../../cli/config-catalog.js'` and the src/config import are asserted `===` identical
reconcileConfig({}, CONFIG_CATALOG) does not throw ConfigCatalogError, and a second pass over its output reports changed === false
An exhaustiveness assertion (never-assignment or tsc-on-fixture) fails to compile if a discriminant member is added without a matching switch arm
A header comment records that the MaintenanceResult contract subject is owned by t11, so every LLD contract-level subject has exactly one owning test

tests.name: source scan over src/config/** resolves every import specifier and asserts none reference src/cli
src/config/config-catalog.ts is the single definition site of CONFIG_CATALOG and ConfigOption
src/cli/config-catalog.ts re-exports both and its CONFIG_CATALOG is === the src/config array (no duplicate literal)
real CONFIG_CATALOG self-consistency — every row's type is in-domain and every default satisfies its own predicate; reconcileConfig({}, CONFIG_CATALOG) does not throw ConfigCatalogError
reconcileConfig({}, CONFIG_CATALOG) is idempotent on the real 41-row catalog — second pass changed === false
type-level exhaustiveness — never-assignment / tsc-on-fixture fails to compile when a ConfigOption discriminant member lacks a switch arm
